description:
Get one taste run you started: its status, the live vote count per option, what it cost, and the report once it is closed.
Use for: checking where a taste run stands and reading its result. While it is collecting, read it again in 20 to 30 minutes.
Not for: reading a QA run (get_qa_run); checking your wallet balance (get_wallet).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_taste_run({"runId":"taste_8Hc2pQ1vLm"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

runId.description: The run id create_taste_run answered with, or one from list_taste_runs.

name: get_taste_run

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

cost.description: Each amount is left out until the run has recorded it.

refunded.description: Given back to your wallet so far.

reserved.description: Set aside from your wallet for this run.

spent.description: Paid out of what was set aside so far.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

failureReason.description: Why the run is blocked or failed, as a short code such as insufficient_wallet_balance or period_cap_reached. Present only when the run is blocked or failed.

fundedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

report.description: Present only when the run is closed.

isDegraded.description: True when the report was written from partial votes.

share.description: This option’s part of the accepted votes, from 0 to 1.

winner.description: The label that won. Left out when there is no clear winner.

respondentCount.description: How many people the run asks for.

status.description: blocked_awaiting_funds: waiting for money in your wallet. collecting: people are voting. reviewing: votes are being checked. closed: done, see report. cancelling, cancelled, expired, failed: over without a full result.

tally.description: Accepted votes per option, as they stand now.

share.description: This option’s part of the accepted votes, from 0 to 1.

title: Get a taste run
